title: Common tasks: classification, regression, clustering and recommendation

videos.script: Lesson 1 trained three things. This lesson is about what they are for. {{recap}} Almost every model a data platform serves answers one of four questions. Which kind is this? How much? Which ones go together? And what next? {{four}} Which kind is classification. Will this member lapse, yes or no. {{class}} How much is regression. How much will they spend in the next ninety days. {{reg}} Which go together is clustering. What kinds of reader does the shop have. {{clust}} And what next is recommendation. Which book should we show this member. {{rec}} Each one gets a program, on the same shop, and each one gets a number. {{numbers}} Then the number that matters more. What the model is worth against guessing. A regression that beats the average by thirty-four reais. A recommender that finds three times what popularity finds. {{baseline}} And last, what each task asks of the platform. When its answer arrives. What it is keyed by. How fresh it has to be. {{needs}} That is the part you will build.
